## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Distinguish implemented
capabilities from planned or unverified ones.

## Validation

List relevant commands and results. Identify compilation, COM checks, installed
Explorer behavior and visual checks separately. Include untested architectures.

## Shell and user data

State whether this changes registration, Explorer lifetime, drop handling,
favorite removal, target files, context menus or permissions.

## Records and provenance

Update the changelog and applicable todo/done/archive entries. Describe material
AI assistance and preserve asset/license provenance.
